name: Phelarion-class fuel tanker
description: The Phelarion-class fuel tanker was a class of fuel tanker manufactured by Rendili StarDrive. It featured two large external fuel tanks and four rear fusion engines. It was also equipped with a deflector shield and a hangar that could accommodate at least three T-70 X-wing starfighters. In 34 ABY, a Phelarion-class tanker carrying fuel for the Resistance was intercepted by the First Order, who stole the fuel using their own tankers and rigged the ship to bomb the Resistance base.
